notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Here you have the list with changes on each patch, if you get a bug let me know and I'll try to solve it ASAP! List will be updated with each patch:

[h1]1.01[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Disappeared and out of place menu buttons for some players is now fixed
[/list]

[h1]1.03[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You will not get more troubles when sometimes phase 4 jumps directly to game over screen
    [*]Due the fixed bug above, extra survive mode now works correctly
[/list]

[h1]1.05[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Responsive time on phase 4 to get the game over screen is now lower
    [*]Phase 5 more easy, time to react is now longer.
[/list]
